# webbpulse_workspaces (Data Source)

Every workspace in the environment. The API takes no filters on its listing route, so this returns all of them and a configuration narrows the result itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_workspaces" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Every workspace id, in the order the API returned them.
- `names` (List of String) Every workspace name, positionally matching `ids`.
